# CalcForHome

> Free, single-purpose calculators for US home-improvement materials: concrete,
> gravel, sand, mulch, lumber and decking. Every calculator runs entirely in the
> browser — no sign-up, nothing sent to a server — shows the formula it uses, and
> cites industry sources (QUIKRETE, Concrete Network, NRMCA, ICC). Frost-depth
> pages cover code-required footing depth for all 50 US states plus Washington DC.

## Concrete calculators

- [Concrete Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/concrete-calculator/): slab and footing volume in cubic feet and cubic yards, with 80 lb bag counts and a slab-size chart
- [Concrete Bags Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/concrete-bags-calculator/): exactly how many 80/60/50/40 lb bags of concrete mix a project needs
- [Concrete Bag Coverage Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/concrete-bag-coverage-calculator/): square feet covered per 80, 60, 50 or 40 lb bag
- [Concrete Slab Cost Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/concrete-slab-cost-calculator/): yards, bags and material cost for any slab size
- [Concrete for Fence Post Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/concrete-fence-post-calculator/): bags of concrete per fence post hole, with buried-post volume subtraction

## Gravel and landscaping calculators

- [Gravel Calculator for Driveways](https://www.calcforhome.com/gravel-driveway-calculator/): cubic yards and tons of gravel by stone type
- [Gravel Driveway Cost Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/gravel-driveway-cost-calculator/): tons and material cost for a gravel driveway
- [Gravel Driveway Depth Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/gravel-driveway-depth-calculator/): base and surface layer depths for cars or trucks
- [Paver Sand Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/paver-sand-calculator/): cubic yards, cubic feet and bags of bedding sand for pavers
- [Mulch Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/mulch-calculator/): cubic yards and bags of mulch for garden beds

## Lumber and decking

- [Lumber Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/lumber-calculator/): studs, plate boards and board feet for a wall
- [Deck Board Calculator](https://www.calcforhome.com/deck-board-calculator/): courses, boards per course and stock length for a deck

## Common slab sizes: bag counts answered

- [10x10](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-10x10-slab/), [10x12](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-10x12-slab/), [10x20](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-10x20-slab/), [12x12](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-12x12-slab/), [12x16](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-12x16-slab/), [12x24](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-12x24-slab/), [16x20](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-16x20-slab/), [20x20](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-20x20-slab/), [20x30](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-20x30-slab/), [24x24](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-24x24-slab/), [24x30](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-24x30-slab/), [30x30](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-many-bags-of-concrete-for-a-30x30-slab/): how many 80/60/40 lb bags of concrete a slab that size needs at 4, 5 and 6 inches thick, with a ready-mix comparison

## Driveway length: gravel quantity answered

- [50 ft](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-much-gravel-for-a-50-ft-driveway/), [60 ft](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-much-gravel-for-a-60-ft-driveway/), [80 ft](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-much-gravel-for-a-80-ft-driveway/), [100 ft](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-much-gravel-for-a-100-ft-driveway/), [150 ft](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-much-gravel-for-a-150-ft-driveway/), [200 ft](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-much-gravel-for-a-200-ft-driveway/), [300 ft](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-much-gravel-for-a-300-ft-driveway/), [400 ft](https://www.calcforhome.com/how-much-gravel-for-a-400-ft-driveway/): cubic yards and tons of crushed stone for a 10 ft wide driveway at 4–8 inches deep, with cost and truckload math

## Frost depth by state

Code-required frost depth and footing depth for all 50 US states and DC, by
county where depths differ within a state. Each page lists dig depth (frost
depth plus 6 inches of bearing), Sonotube length, concrete bag counts per hole
diameter, and answers common footing and fence-post questions. All values are
also available as a downloadable CSV.

- [Frost Depth by State (hub)](https://www.calcforhome.com/frost-depth-by-state/)
